criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.validation.validate_entries(library, *, rules=None, version="bibtex-v1"). Supply explicit article/book rules, required fields and alternative author/editor groups; treat empty/None as absent and allow custom required/one_of/allowed rules. Return ordered structured diagnostics with key, field, stable code and real available source line. Unknown types/fields must be reported without deleting data. Preserve original Library and permissive parser behavior; reject unsupported rule versions.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
